==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Cursed Lizalfos}}
Cursed Lizalfos are the skulls of [[Lizalfos]] that have been revived by [[Malice]].<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They are noted to have retained their sly demeanor, being faster than their [[Cursed Bokoblin]] counterparts.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> In addition to this, they attack anyone that approaches them.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/>

Like the Cursed Bokoblins and Cursed Moblins, Cursed Lizalfos only appear in the four [[Divine Beast]]s and [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. They appear from [[Pool of Malice|Pools of Malice]] that have mouths. When the [[Glowing Eyeball]] attached to the Pool of Malice spots [[Link]], it will begin to spit out Cursed Lizalfos. Due to their low health, they can be destroyed with a single hit. Destroying the Glowing Eyeball will halt the spawning of Cursed Lizalfos.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
Cursed Lizalfos reappear in {{AoC}}, only seen after [[Stalizalfos]] are defeated and charge at the player while chasing them.
{{Noncanon|End}}
